name: matched-ks3-all-rank2-width1536-normlr
hypothesis: Increase rank-two KS3 projection width from1024 to1536 in every dense and routed feedforward branch:768 charts with two coordinates each. Test whether more coupled chart capacity improves the timed learning curve after the1024-feature rank-two candidate was proxy-pruned. Normalize projection rate by sqrt(1024/1536) to preserve original effective ANVIL rates. Keep existing GS32/BF16 rank-two equations and kernels, geometry Adam0.125, zero coefficients, projection decay, MoE8top1 and all shared/model-wide settings fixed. Require independent dense and routed output/all-gradient oracles plus actual full graph warmup before training.
